title: The Unitary Conjugation Groupoid as a Universal Mediator of the Baum--Connes Assembly Map
summary: We show that the Baum--Connes assembly map factors canonically through the unitary conjugation groupoid, which serves as a universal mediator among groupoid models that are Morita equivalent to a given transformation groupoid. This establishes a structural link between groupoid-based index theory and the Baum--Connes program at the level of K-theory.
